text: At its meeting held October 9 and 10, 2024, City Council appointed Apt'sqi'gnn to the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, and Queer (2SLGBTQ+) Advisory Committee for a term of office ending on November 14, 2026, or until their mandate is completed, whichever comes first. This new appointment fills the position previously held by Morrigana Townsend whose term of office came to an end on July 5, 2024.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received the item for information.
